# @ndigo/platform-node

Node.js platform adapter for Ndigo — HTTP server, auto-configuration, static files, multipart

Version-matched export index for the installed package. Read `README.md`
for usage; the workspace guide index ships with `@ndigo/cli` as
`assets/agent/docs-index.md`.

## Subpaths

- `@ndigo/platform-node/node-auto-configuration`
